left_primary_base.role: primary comparator, sealed bytes, never re-flown or re-scored

right_twin.role: registered form twin, deranged speech key, token-matched

claim_boundary: Descriptive paired read on historically exposed TRAIN Fold A discovery rows. No superiority, generalization, component-causal or confirmatory claim; nothing about Fold B, DEV-1000 or the test split.
contrasts: arm minus secondary anchor (reported, never a gate)
twin minus primary base (reported: what twenty unrelated exemplars alone do)

decision_rule.ADMITTED: CI95 lower bound of the pooled SLU delta > 0 versus the primary base AND versus the twin, intent non-inferior within 0.92 pp, normalised scorer same sign, no scenario intent loss beyond the null band
decision_rule.HARMFUL: otherwise, when a guard fails on the losing side
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: otherwise; enters the default plan only if it lowers cost

delta_convention: delta = B1 arm minus its comparator, in percentage points; negative is worse
diagnostics_required: candidate-union coverage realized in the delivered answer, against the A2 availability number 0.972
Solver escape-to-neighbour-intent rate: the share of rows whose delivered intent is absent from the sealed Perception candidates but present among the supplied exemplar intents
exemplar token volume actually rendered per row, against the 1,083-token estimated maximum

estimators.not_used: analysis.score_compare_cli as the runner: it hard-codes ci_level 0.90 and DEV population names

metrics.counts: tp = [slu_f1_word_tp, slu_f1_char_tp], fp and fn likewise

metrics.estimand: per-row mean of joint scenario+action correctness

roster_metadata.carries: sample_id -> scenario, speaker, headset, utterance_id; no text, transcript or gold filler
roster_metadata.speaker_key: spk:<usrid> from the governed SLURP release metadata, the 2026-09-09 own-null convention

rebase_rule: If cell B0 is HARMFUL, the primary base becomes the sealed anchor and the coordinator re-bases both cells on it before launch.

resampling.seed_advance: paired_contrast advances the seed by the metric index; pooled metrics use the base seed
resampling.sensitivity: paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed, each scenario resampled to its own size

scorer.runs: once per complete manifest through core.scoring_batch, never sharded; this read invokes no scorer

tables_required: headline: base, arm, twin, delta versus base, delta versus twin, speaker CI95, speaker CI90, scenario-stratified CI90, equal-scenario delta
saves / harms / ties with the exact two-sided McNemar p for every per-row metric, against the base and against the twin
per-scenario table, all 18 scenarios, natural mixture and equal weighting
cost table: contacts, contacts per row, repeated speech seconds, FIT endpoints, GPU hours from the serving monitor, mean latency, duty cycle, exemplar token volume
title: SLURP TRAIN A: exemplar-supplied Solver (cell B1) versus the review-off base and its derangement twin
